text:
Predicates:
OlympicEvent(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic game.
LastEvent(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic game.
Location(x, y) ::: x took place in location y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x is the team that won the most medals in event y.
UnitedStates(y) ::: y is the United States.
Tokyo(y) ::: y is Tokyo.

Premises:
OlympicEvent(lastEvent) ∧ Location(lastEvent, Tokyo) ∧ WonMostMedals(UnitedStates, lastEvent) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo and the United States won the most medals there.

Conclusion:
¬(LastEvent(lastEvent) ∧ Location(lastEvent, Tokyo)) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
